title: Rain for Nomvula
summary: It is very hot, and Nomvula wants to play in the water, but Mom reminds her there isn't much water. Then the rain starts to fall, and Nomvula discovers that rain has a funny side too.
pages: "No, Nomvula, don't play in the water. There is so little water!" "But it's hot, Mama! I want to get in that water. I want to cool down."
"No, Nomvula. Don't play in the water. There isn't much water." "But it's hot, Mama, and I'm thirsty. I want to drink cold water."
It's raining. There will be lots of water. Now I can't play. I wish it were hot.
Look at the vegetables. They are growing and turning green. Look! The bowls and buckets are so full of water that they overflow.
The rain has stopped. Now we can play! Look how beautiful everything is after the rain. The sky is clean and blue. The trees and grass are green, and the plants are blooming.
Oh, no! Here comes the rain again! When will we ever play?

Oh, I don't care! I'm going to play, even if it's raining! Oh, what fun it is to play in the rain. Splash splash splash! My dress is wet! My dress is wet! Splash splash splash! My hair is wet! My hair is wet!
Nomvula, you just won't listen, my child. Come here, I'll dry your hair and comb it. Splash splash splash! Your hair is wet! Your hair is wet!
